overview: Butki is a short-video and photo-sharing social media app with Instagram-like features plus a built-in Refer & Earn system. Users share reels, stories, and posts, earn real money by inviting friends, and manage earnings in an in-app wallet with UPI/bank withdrawal.
features: User auth with username/email/phone signup and OTP
Home feed, explore, and vertical reels with music
Stories with creative tools: filters, stickers, text, music
Like, comment, share, and save on posts and reels
Direct messaging with audio and video call UI
Refer & Earn: unique referral codes, ₹10/₹20/₹50 reward tiers
In-app wallet with transaction history and UPI/bank withdrawal
Admin panel for user management, post moderation, and payout approvals
Profile with referral code display, wallet balance, highlights
